rows.name: Cave Bat
rows.notes: Repaired fully transparent palette restores the actual bat body and all embedded clips. Natural fur/chest/membrane colors replace purple/yellow. Large ears, wing panels and feet read as a bat; anatomy remains very angular without fur detail or convincing hooked claws.

rows.name: Animated Statue
rows.notes: A carved civic guardian with face, laurel, mantle, ceremonial spear and decorated shield replaces the floating winged proxy. Revised spear points upright and has a leaf-shaped leading tip. Anatomy, cloak folds and weathering remain simplified.

rows.name: Kobold Emberkeeper
rows.notes: Copper reptilian head/tail, ceremonial clothing, ribbed scalloped wings and a suspended coal/flame brazier replace the orc. Two revisions corrected sideways gear, glider wings and excessive chain drop. Chunky anatomy, flat materials and extreme-pose tail clipping remain.
